mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.project_name, p.project_code, p.category_id, p.level, p.region, p.batch_no, p.announce_year, p.type, p.protection_unit, p.cover_url, p.summary, p.audit_status, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.sort_no, p.create_time, p.update_time, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM ich_project p LEFT JOIN ich_category c ON c.id = p.category_id
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.*, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM ich_project p LEFT JOIN ich_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.project_name, p.project_code, p.category_id, p.level, p.region, p.batch_no, p.announce_year, p.type, p.cover_url, p.summary, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM ich_project p LEFT JOIN ich_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.audit_status = 1 ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
